en.title: Mango Ice Cream with Chantilly Cream

steps.n1: Combine the milk, sugar, and juice, then blend with an electric mixer until smooth.
steps.n2: Add the chantilly cream powder to the mixture and whip with the mixer until well combined.
steps.n3: Pour into a mold and place in the freezer.

legacySteps: Combine the milk, sugar, and juice, then blend with an electric mixer until smooth.
Add the chantilly cream powder to the mixture and whip with the mixer until well combined.
Pour into a mold and place in the freezer.
